collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IX: REPAIR, FAIRNESS AND MANY FUTURES (LCI-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
From the owner's Volume V concepts (401-500), the 30 themes and the five deeper subjects: old wrongs and their repair, who is heard, prejudice and fairness, care for minds and bodies, animals and hard tradeoffs, inventions and bad inventions, family life, and an island that keeps choosing its own future.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Builders find a bird's nest under a roof they must repair: wait until the chicks leave, or move the nest.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) have climbed up to fix the leaking roof of the healing hut, and found a nest of tiny birds under the thatch. The chicks are weeks from flying. The roof leaks onto the patients. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They patch the roof from inside, around the nest, which is awkward and only half works. The healers move the patients away from the drips. Three weeks later, the chicks fly. The roof is fixed the next day.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) carefully moves the nest to a sheltered branch nearby. The parents circle, screaming, for an hour. Then they find it. The roof is fixed. Two of the four chicks survive. (friend) is not sure it was right.
